title: Sage hitboxes record
description: A hitboxes record (HitboxesRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another hitboxes record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

model.description: The skinned model (.glb) whose skeleton these boxes are on. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

location.description: The hit_location a strike on this box lands on. Names a hit_location record. (RecordRef<HitLocationRecord>)

bone.description: The joint it follows, by name as the model writes it. (string)

socket.description: Or a socket of the model (skeleton_sockets), which wins over the bone. (string)

shape.description: Box, Sphere or Capsule, in the joint's space. (ColliderShape)

size.description: Box: full extents. Sphere: X is the radius. Capsule: X radius, Y cylinder length (along the joint's Y) Unit: m. At least 0. (Vector3)

offset.description: Where its centre sits in the joint's space. Unit: m. (Vector3)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
